about_the_game:
HamsterCraft is a fast-paced, cheese-fueled Tower Defense game where strategy meets silliness.

Build your defense using a growing roster of Heroic Hamsters—Each with unique attacks, upgrades, and playstyles. Face off against quirky enemy waves, unlock powerful trinkets, and climb the cheese ladder to glory.

- 🧀 Campaign!

  A carefully crafted journey across unique levels where strategy meets story. Master each          stage and defend your cheese empire one wave at a time!

- 🌀 Endless - ARAM Mode!

 Jump into a wild, procedurally generated battlefield where no two runs are ever the same!   Infinite scaling — pure chaos, infinite fun!

- 🏆 Ranked Mode!

 Climb the global leaderboard! Test your skills in seasonal runs with fair rules, competitive   loadouts, and leaderboard rewards. Strategy matters — but so does style.

- 📜 Daily Quest!

 Fresh challenges every day! Complete bite-sized missions for cheese crystal, boosts, and   bonus goodies. Perfect for a quick squeaky session.

- 🏅 Achievements!

 Unlock hamster glory! From silly to skillful, collect dozens of in-game achievements that   show off your cheese defense legacy.

- 🎨 In-Game Shop!

 Drip your defense! Spend your hard-earned crystal cheese on, skins, and trinkets — all purely   cosmetic, all squeak-approved. No pay-to-win, just play-to-stylize.

- 💥 Come Get Now!

"Competitive... but still squeaky fun!"

A perfect blend of lighthearted chaos and real strategic depth — for casual defenders and leaderboard legends alike.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64bit)
  • Processor: 1.5Ghz or better (x86-64)
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 8-compatible graphics card with at least 32MB of video memory
  • DirectX: Version 8.0
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64bit)
  • Processor: 2Ghz or better (x86-64)
  • Memory: 8192 MB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 8-compatible graphics card with at least 32MB of video memory
  • DirectX: Version 8.0
  • Storage: 500 MB available space

short_description: Defend and grow your cheese with an army of heroic hamsters in this chaotic 2D Tower Defense adventure! Build, upgrade, and outwit waves of enemies, all while keeping things squeaky clean.
